title: a FamilySearch results page with no rows is a none run, not a page with no identity
line: a saved-from line that is the site's own record search URL is an fs_search page whatever the body holds; the site's "No Results" answers the fetch step whose citation was searched for by that name in that collection with a none run, the search as run, and the step is not listed again until its fields change

steps.say: before the page arrives, a turn can still open Annie's marriage-records search: nothing has answered it
the search saved: the site answered No Results, saved from the search's own URL as any results page is

expect.why: read as an fs_search page from its saved-from line, whatever its body holds (no result row's own markup at all): it fulfils every fetch step whose citation was searched for this name in this collection, on both sides of the couple; no rows at all, so the run is none
the step's log row: none, the search as run, the page as its artifact
no rows at all: nothing to hold as a candidate

steps.say: a turn does not send anyone to it again until the plan changes its fields

expect.why: the citation's own search, already answered none on these fields
